purpose: isolate replay protection and adaptive weighting from ordinary new-task learning
experiment_type: new matched-start loss-condition controls; not retry of completed adaptive training
scope: exploratory one-seed matched-start controls; not confirmatory PACT-full efficacy
initial_model: same preserved completed MedBook stage1 checkpoint as existing adaptive stage2

old_data.fixed_margin: same338 immutable training references, no reconstruction or gold substitution

fixed_weight_selection: unit coefficient by definition; no sweep or selection from control results
new_data: same full prepared PathVQA train split and seed100 sampler;200updates,4questions/update
training: same published development stage2 GRPOConfig: bf16 full-parameter ZeRO3 GSPO sequence importance, G8, localbatch4/GAS4, lr5e-6 fresh AdamW foreachFalse, beta0, num_iterations1, steps_per_generation1
prompt: fixed canonical for all8 trajectories; matches actual adaptive stage2 with empty cards; no dynamic proposer in either control
decoder: single-trajectory sequential generation,128tokens,temp1,repetition1 sampled; logprobs use actual prompt
fixed_margin_replay: match actual historical code:2 uniform draws/rank with replacement, reuse across4 accumulated microsteps, same margin/tau objective and seed100000+2step+rank; do not silently impose distinctness
fixed_margin_audit: same32 uniform old-memory draws every10updates including0, EMA computed for diagnostics; weight exactly1 regardless of audit
primary_outcomes: both full validation accuracies130 MedBook and6259 PathVQA; report all raw correct/n and old/new tradeoff vs original adaptive and initial; no metric selection
evaluation: canonical, single-example greedy128/repetition1, same frozen scorer/processor/pixels, no test read
cost_reporting: same new-data optimizer updates, not equal compute; plain has no old-memory forwards; fixed has3200 replay and640 old-audit forwards across ranks, plus shared original memory-construction costs not re-incurred; disabled strategy audit/proposer differs in overhead from adaptive
checkpoint: shared read-only initial model and each control final model preserved; no in-arm exact optimizer/sampler resume, no rolling fullAdam state
guards: one independent supervisor clock for both controls and evaluation; failure/stat error/byte/time stops all current children, no automatic retry; preserve any completed control
stopping: all2 training arms200updates plus both full validation denominators; any failure retained, no changed seed/config/sample search or re-labeled retry
privacy: aggregate only; no images/questions/per-example outputs/private references/weights/rawlogs made public
limitations: all conditions chosen after initial method validation was known; exploratory
historical replay-distinctness deviation retained; controls match actual with-replacement implementation
this is direct-answer cross-task GSPO control, not the explicitly stopped question-type experiment
